name: wildfire_elemental_pump_ends_with_the_turn
notes: G3 (until-end-of-turn->permanent at 1/0/effect/args/duration). Printed: 'Whenever an opponent is dealt noncombat damage, creatures you control get +1/+0 until end of turn.' Seat 0 Shocks the opponent (20 -> 18): the trigger pumps seat 0's creatures for this turn only. After the turn ends the 3/3 Elemental and the 2/2 Bear are back to their printed power; the opponent's Bear was never pumped.
